newsitem.title: CHINA: SHK Prop offers more Grand Del Sol flats.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop offers more Grand Del Sol flats.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Tuesday it would offer an additional 224 units of its Grand Del Sol development in Hong Kong's New Territories for sale, bringing the total number of flats on offer to 730.
A company spokeswoman said all the 730 units in the luxury residential development would be offered for sale at an average price of HK$5,100 a square foot on Saturday.
The spokeswoman said a total 2,241 potential buyers had registered to buy the flats at close of a six-day registration on Tuesday.
Sun Hung Kai Properties initially offered 242 units at an average price of HK$5,100 a square foot before it put on a second batch of 264 units and now a third batch of 224 units for sale.
Grand Del Sol in Ha Yau Tin in Yuen Long, covers 280,000 square foot. The development comprises 1,100 units in thirteen 11-storey residential blocks with a total floor area of 856,000 square feet.
The units range from 682 to 905 square feet. The development is scheduled for completion in October 1997.
Grand Del Sol is the first large scale residential development to go on sale in Hong Kong since the territory reverted to Chinese ruling at midnight on June 30.
